sources.title: Photo guide
sources.text:
# Photo uploads
Bloom accepts JPG, PNG and WebP photos. The maximum file size is 5 MB. GIF and HEIC files are not accepted. Convert them to JPG, PNG or WebP before uploading.
# Journal entries
Each journal entry has a title, date, caption and optional photo. Captions can contain up to 280 characters.

sources.title: Search guide
sources.text:
# Caption search
Search matches all query words within the caption of entries owned by the signed-in visitor. Words can appear in any order. Search does not inspect pixels inside photos or match journal titles. A visitor cannot search another visitor's entries.

sources.title: Synthetic export guide
sources.text:
# Export
In this synthetic evaluation company, CSV export contains date, title and caption. Photos are not embedded in CSV. Export is available from Settings, then Export journal.
